findings.message: Codex review of TASK-052 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Release documentation is complete and operationally sound.
Release-readiness runbooks for all three deployment modes (local-only, family-cloud, classroom) are comprehensive and actionable, providing clear operational guidance for each environment.
Launch checklist is thorough, covering rollback procedures, incident response protocols, support escalation paths, and AI fallback controls. All critical release activities are addressed.
Release exit criteria define clear production readiness gates across safety, performance, and compliance dimensions. Provides unambiguous go/no-go decision framework for releases.
Release documentation README.md provides clear overview and navigation for all release-related materials, making it easy for operators to find relevant information.
Main README.md properly references new release documentation, ensuring discoverability for users and operators.
Quality gates validation passes: run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0) confirms no regressions introduced by release documentation changes.
Operational completeness and alignment with manual QA/release handoff workflows have been reviewed and confirmed appropriate for production operations.
